title: Sports and Hobbies
text:
My name is Anna. I like sports. On Saturday I play football with my friends. We play in the park. It is fun.

My brother likes music. He plays the guitar every evening. My mother likes swimming. She goes to the pool on Monday and Thursday.

questions.text: What sport does Anna play on Saturday?
What instrument does Anna's brother play?
How does Anna probably feel about playing football with her friends?
What can we guess about Anna's mother?
options: She enjoys being active in the water.

vocabulary.definition: a sport played by two teams with a ball, mostly using the feet
people you know well and like
the sport of moving through water
the part of the day after the afternoon

paragraph_translations: Мене звати Анна. Я люблю спорт. У суботу я граю у футбол з друзями. Ми граємо в парку. Це весело.
Мій брат любить музику. Він грає на гітарі кожного вечора. Моя мама любить плавання. Вона ходить у басейн у понеділок і четвер.
